outcome.interpretation: The selected-session projection has seven current scheduler result records with verified content identity, while service verification remains not-established. Its 14 scoped invocations refer to two older execution identities outside the latest trace, and the bounded retained rows did not yet expose their scheduler result classifications.
outcome.scope: This is an observed trace-continuity limitation. Content integrity verifies result identity and digest only; neither it nor a recorded scheduler result establishes service correctness, agent receipt, need fulfillment, or reduced intervention.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Owner-result evidence is lost when the scheduler trace is replaced
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment incremental owner-pass results, retained execution history, and capability-intelligence projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A live selected-session projection contained seven result-recorded owner results with content-integrity-verified source records and verification_status=not-established. Older scoped invocation events remained outside the latest trace without retained result classification.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry the bounded scheduler result classification and its explicit verification limit into retained execution history, then expose it through the existing exact owner/execution correlation.

measurement_limits: The selected session snapshot predates population of the retained owner-result fields, so it does not demonstrate a live retained-result match.
A scheduler result record and verified content identity do not establish service correctness, usefulness, receipt, need fulfillment, or reduced agent intervention.
The two older invocation groups are observed activity; their absence from the latest trace alone does not prove a service failure.
